$comment: Batch 5 standalone-lab isolation (ADR-014 follow-up). Single source of truth for sandbox tokens: next.config.mjs emits `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox <tokens>` on every raw and served path, and the app/ iframe wrappers use the same tokens via lib/standalone-labs.ts. No lab gets allow-same-origin. Labs with "sandbox": null are exempt (recorded reason) and excluded from the /standalone catch-all.

EXEMPT, could not be isolated without breaking. The app is a gzip+base64 payload in index.html that runtime.html decodes and document.writes; it calls localStorage unguarded (theme init, theme switch, evidence checklist) and print(). Sandboxed, the init throws SecurityError: theme, checklist and Print/PDF break (verified in headless Chrome). Same-origin, no external origins. Follow-up: guard storage inside the payload, then sandbox with allow-scripts allow-modals.
